errors.deleteAccount: Couldn't delete the account. Try again.

errors.replacedElsewhere: Kraki is open in another tab or window. Come back to this tab to use it here.

scanner.noCamera: No camera found. Connect a camera, or open the pairing link on this device instead.
scanner.unavailable: Couldn’t start the camera. Close other apps using it and try again.
scanner.pointAt: Point at the QR code from <command>kraki connect</command>

pairing.unavailable: Kraki for iPhone is not available yet. You can connect in this browser instead.
